causalAutopsy.notes: Latent since #2155 shipped buildNatives copying exactly one script file while that script required a sibling. It could not surface until the rebuild itself started succeeding, which only happened after the HOME fix in #2259 — so the first production run of #2259 revealed this next layer. Attempt 4 reported "native rebuild failed (exit 1): rebuilt dependencies successfully", which is also what exposed the tail heuristic preferring the succeeding half of a chained command.
